sentence: Forge no bilinguombo while still too sigmuff to share it.

wombos.definition: A wombo that blends words from two different languages into a single coined term. Quát and Thacias are classic bilinguombos.
wombos.example: Nihowdy is a perfect bilinguombo — it fuses Ni Hao and Howdy into one greeting.

wombos.definition: Tough and rough in a sigma way — so lone-wolf independent that it comes across as gruff and unpolished. 'The rizzonance coming off him was sigmuff after he ate that burger.'
